cards.example_en: This idiom means to start again.
cards.example_zh: 这条习语的意思是重新开始。

cards.example_en: Don't ignore the warning signs.
cards.example_zh: 不要忽视雾警标志。

cards.example_en: Parking on the pavement is illegal in our city.
cards.example_zh: 在我们这座城市，把车停在人行道上是非法的。

cards.example_en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
cards.example_zh: 让我用一个例子来说明我的观点。

cards.example_en: A blurry image of the moon filled the telescope screen.
cards.example_zh: 一幅模糊的月亮图像占满了望远镜的屏幕。

cards.example_en: Please come immediately.
cards.example_zh: 请立刻过来。

cards.example_en: The internet has had a huge impact on our lives.
cards.example_zh: 互联网对我们的生活产生了巨大的影响。

cards.example_en: His faint smile seemed to imply that he agreed.
cards.example_zh: 他淡淡的微笑似乎在暗示他同意了。

cards.example_en: The country will import oil.
cards.example_zh: 这个国家将进口石油。

cards.example_en: Her confident speech can impress the whole school.
cards.example_zh: 她自信的发言能给全校同学留下深刻印象。

cards.example_en: The museum left a deep impression on my little sister.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆给我妹妹留下了深刻的印象。

cards.example_en: The puddle grew an inch deeper after the noon storm.
cards.example_zh: 中午的暴风雨过后，水坑又深了一英寸。

cards.example_en: A minor incident in the hallway delayed the fire drill.
cards.example_zh: 走廊里的一件小事耽误了消防演习。

cards.example_en: Extra income from weekend work pays for his art supplies.
cards.example_zh: 周末打工的额外收入用来买他的美术用品。

cards.example_en: The view from the top was incredible.
cards.example_zh: 山顶的景色令人难以置信。

cards.example_en: The story is indeed true.
cards.example_zh: 这个故事确实是真的。

cards.example_en: She became more independent at university.
cards.example_zh: 她在大学里变得更加独立。

cards.example_en: The results indicate a clear trend.
cards.example_zh: 结果表明了一个明显的趋势。

cards.example_en: Each student received individual feedback on the essay.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生都收到了针对作文的个别反馈。

cards.example_en: A skin infection kept him out of the swimming pool.
cards.example_zh: 皮肤感染让他不能去游泳池。

cards.example_en: What can you infer from the last paragraph?
cards.example_zh: 你能从最后一段推断出什么？

cards.example_en: She is an influential writer.
cards.example_zh: 她是一位有影响力的作家。

cards.example_en: My initial reaction was surprise.
cards.example_zh: 我最初的反应是惊讶。

cards.example_en: She took the initiative and booked the room for our meeting.
cards.example_zh: 她采取主动行动，为我们的会议订好了房间。

cards.example_en: He missed the game because of an injury.
cards.example_zh: 他因伤缺席了比赛。

cards.example_en: The inner pocket of my coat held the bus ticket.
cards.example_zh: 我外套里面的口袋装着公交票。

cards.example_en: The report said he was innocent.
cards.example_zh: 报告说他是无辜的。

cards.example_en: The company is famous for innovation.
cards.example_zh: 这家公司以创新闻名。

cards.example_en: Wrong input from the keyboard ruined the saved document.
cards.example_zh: 键盘输入错误，毁掉了已经保存的文档。

cards.example_en: I will inquire about the train time.
cards.example_zh: 我会询问火车时间。

cards.example_en: Living on the farm gave me insight into how crops grow.
cards.example_zh: 住在农场让我明白了庄稼是怎么生长的。

cards.example_en: Mum will insist on warm coats in this cold wind.
cards.example_zh: 风这么冷，妈妈一定会坚持让我们穿厚外套。

cards.example_en: Health inspection closed the snack bar for two days.
cards.example_zh: 卫生查验让小吃店停业了两天。

cards.example_en: Good teachers inspire students to learn.
cards.example_zh: 好老师激励学生学习。

cards.example_en: This delay is one instance of buses running late in snow.
cards.example_zh: 这次晚点就是公交车在雪天误点的一个例子。

cards.example_en: I need an instant reply.
cards.example_zh: 我需要立即答复。

cards.example_en: The research institute is near the university.
cards.example_zh: 这家研究机构在大学附近。

cards.example_en: The weekly assembly is an institution at our school now.
cards.example_zh: 每周的集会现在已经成了我们学校的一项制度。

cards.example_en: Bike insurance paid for a new wheel after the crash.
cards.example_zh: 自行车保险在事故后赔了一只新车轮。

cards.example_en: The coach will integrate new players into the team.
cards.example_zh: 教练会让新队员融入这支球队。

cards.example_en: Honesty is part of personal integrity.
cards.example_zh: 诚实是个人正直的一部分。

cards.example_en: Dolphins are intelligent animals.
cards.example_zh: 海豚是聪明的动物。

cards.example_en: I intend to visit my grandparents this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我打算这个周末去看望爷爷奶奶。

cards.example_en: The heat was intense at noon.
cards.example_zh: 中午热得厉害。

cards.example_en: My intention was to return the book before the library closed.
cards.example_zh: 我的用意是在图书馆关门前把书还回去。

cards.example_en: Real interaction started when we swapped roles in the scene.
cards.example_zh: 我们在场景里交换角色后，真正的互动才开始。

cards.example_en: The doctor checked for internal injuries after the fall.
cards.example_zh: 摔倒之后，医生检查了有没有内伤。

cards.example_en: How do you interpret this poem?
cards.example_zh: 你如何诠释这首诗？

cards.example_en: Please don't interrupt the speaker.
cards.example_zh: 请不要打断发言的人。

cards.example_en: The teacher's intervention stopped the argument.
cards.example_zh: 老师的介入制止了争吵。

word.example_en: She will insist on a written reply.
word.example_zh: 她会坚决要求书面答复。
